method.performed_by: two independent AI sub-agents; no human usability claim
method.initial_input: Exact Chinese README Copy-Paste Prompt plus the requested project scenario, workspace and explicit GitHub/Toy permissions.
method.later_parent_messages: Evidence/report format and status requests; parent acknowledged the recovery plan the agent found in public docs and required preserving the first failure separately. No implementation, credentials or CLI location supplied.
method.prompt:
请把我正在处理的网页项目接入哔哩哔哩 Toy；如果当前目录是空的，就从最小可运行项目开始。
先阅读当前工作区和 AGENTS.md、现有构建与部署方式，
再查看 https://github.com/drdavid-kor/bilibili-toy-deploy 的最新已发布测试版文档和 toy-github Skill。
可用时优先使用 Skill，否则按同版本指南执行。
已有纯 HTML 或 Vite（含 React/Vue）项目请做最小适配，保留原有功能、未提交改动和部署流程；
空目录则建立模板，业务方向不明确时只问完成项目所必需的问题。
填写真实构建命令与输出目录，修好 Toy 子路径下的资源和路由，
准备封面、图标、toy.config.json 与同版本 GitHub 工作流。
先完成本地构建、静态预检和必要的页面检查；在你有权限时，连接我自己的 GitHub 仓库、
推送主分支，打开并核验真实 Toy 预览。
登录只在本机用官方 toy login，并用发行版的 set_secret.py 写入 GitHub Secret；
缺少账号或权限时告诉我具体操作，不索要或输出令牌。
只有在我明确要求提交审核时，才为已预览的同一提交发布普通 GitHub Release 并复用那份预览包；
缺包时先补预览，手动 override 只能经我明确指定，不能暗中提审。
若必须重做后端、登录或存储，先说明影响并等我决定。
最后交付改了什么、验证结果和运行链接、以后如何更新、实际阻碍；
“已提交审核”不能写成“已上线”。
method.acceptance_revision: User explicitly replaced the human trial requirement with these two sub-agent trials.

existing_project.preserved: Application source, build.mjs, server.mjs, package.json, package-lock.json and wrangler.jsonc unchanged; root reviewer verified the diff.
existing_project.result: submitted for review; release build skipped; same commit, artifact and package; override=false
existing_project.authentication: Existing official local Toy login reused; release set_secret.py safely configured Actions Secret. No fresh interactive login was required or claimed.
limits: Private run logs may be inaccessible to external readers.
Hosted phone viewport not separately checked in this trial.
No claim of final publication or unchanged Cloudflare runtime; configuration/source diff was checked.

new_project.initial_result: build and precheck succeeded; publish stopped before upload because another Toy in this account lacked a verifiable URL/slug while auditing.
new_project.status: passed after documented recovery; submitted for review; release build skipped; same commit/artifact/package; override=false
local_checks: Static precheck passed; unhashed JS/CSS filename warning only
Start, hard drop, hold, touch rotation, pause/resume, scoring
new_project.separate_local_cli_preview: Created and played while Action was blocked; not counted as an Action preview or review submission.
new_project.recovery: After the other Toy acquired a verifiable URL, agent manually previewed the original commit with the same public beta.3 workflow.
new_project.authentication: Existing official local session verified and safely transferred with release set_secret.py; fresh interactive login not claimed.
friction: A different pending Toy without a URL temporarily blocked automatic slug resolution in this new repository.
limits: The initial failed Action run remains failed; later success was a separate manual preview run.

follow_up.documentation: Added the cross-project pending-URL limitation and safe retry path to troubleshooting and both quickstarts.

reviewer_verification.github: Both successful preview/release pairs, matching source SHAs and package hashes, release build skipped, override=false, binding records and repository visibility independently rechecked.
reviewer_verification.scope: This later read-only CLI observation is separate from the agents' earlier auditing observations; Action success itself still means submission acceptance.
reviewer_verification.published_browser_check: Both official URLs opened in the browser after publication. Blockfall start screen and controls rendered; Muzzle Lab displayed its 3D model and teaching interface. Agent interaction checks remain recorded separately.
